`class SignalReplayException`<br/>
**Extends:** `RuntimeException`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.internal.signal.replay` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SignalReplayException.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/internal/signal/replay/SignalReplayException.java)

Reason why the replay cannot follow an expression, with the advice that the dev warning prints.

## Description

The replay throws and catches it internally; it reaches application code only through the warning text.
